# SRouter Docs

> Source-grounded documentation for SRouter, a local-first AI gateway for coding tools and applications.

SRouter puts one inspectable endpoint between clients and model providers. The workspace contains a Hono API gateway, React dashboard, terminal CLI, Astro documentation site, and shared runtime packages.

- Default gateway: http://localhost:3000
- API base URL: http://localhost:3000/v1
- Documentation site: https://srouter.web.id

## Start here

- [Overview](https://srouter.web.id/): Map the SRouter workspace and the request path through the gateway.
- [Getting started](https://srouter.web.id/docs/getting-started/): Connect a provider, create a key, configure the gateway, and send a first request.
- [Installation](https://srouter.web.id/docs/installation/): Install SRouter with Docker or run it directly from the source code.
- [Architecture](https://srouter.web.id/docs/concepts/architecture/): See how the API, dashboard, CLI, and shared packages fit together.

## Build with SRouter

- [Request lifecycle](https://srouter.web.id/docs/concepts/request-lifecycle/): Follow a request from authentication and validation to translation and streaming.
- [Providers and routing](https://srouter.web.id/docs/concepts/providers-routing/): Configure provider edges, model prefixes, combos, and fallback behavior.
- [Keys and observability](https://srouter.web.id/docs/concepts/keys-observability/): Use virtual API keys and inspect quotas, logs, analytics, and pricing.

## Integrate

- [OpenAI-compatible API](https://srouter.web.id/docs/integrations/openai/): Connect OpenAI SDKs and clients to SRouter chat completions.
- [Anthropic-compatible API](https://srouter.web.id/docs/integrations/anthropic/): Connect Anthropic SDKs and clients to the messages endpoint.
- [Streaming and SSE](https://srouter.web.id/docs/integrations/streaming/): Understand streaming responses, events, retries, and live telemetry.
- [Coding tools](https://srouter.web.id/docs/integrations/coding-tools/): Configure Claude Code and OpenCode with the SRouter CLI.

## Reference

- [API routes](https://srouter.web.id/docs/reference/api-routes/): Browse the complete mounted HTTP route surface and its auth boundary.
- [Authentication](https://srouter.web.id/docs/reference/authentication/): Choose between virtual API keys, admin sessions, OAuth, and CSRF protection.
- [Environment variables](https://srouter.web.id/docs/reference/environment/): Configure ports, storage, OAuth callbacks, serving, and runtime behavior.
- [Errors and limits](https://srouter.web.id/docs/reference/errors/): Understand validation errors, rate limits, body limits, and upstream failures.

## Project

- [CLI](https://srouter.web.id/docs/cli/): Configure SRouter and connected coding tools from the terminal.
- [Shared packages](https://srouter.web.id/docs/packages/): Trace contracts, persistence, executors, translators, providers, and pricing.
- [Database](https://srouter.web.id/docs/development/database/): Understand SQLite defaults, PostgreSQL support, schema initialization, and transfer.
- [Testing and verification](https://srouter.web.id/docs/development/testing/): Run focused checks without hiding failures behind broad workspace commands.
- [Contributing](https://srouter.web.id/docs/contributing/): Make focused changes while preserving application and package boundaries.
